question: My triceps extension has been stuck for weeks. What should I change?
diagnosis: Triceps extension has not improved its best e1RM for several sessions while your HRV, resting heart rate and sleep are in their normal range, so this looks like a plateau at the current rep range rather than a recovery problem. Weekly running volume is well below the 10 % cap, so there is room to build it a little.
notes_for_user: Nothing changes until you approve it. If triceps still stalls in 3-4 weeks, ask me again.
